title: Does Reasoning Effort Correlate With Honesty? Effort-as-a-Signal Audit

original_idea.body: Correlate per-response reasoning effort with faithfulness and pressure-resistance.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests whether effort is a cheap monitorable honesty signal, directly relevant to CoT monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: measure CoT length, correlate with faithfulness/pressure resistance; clear method.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused correlational study; minor dependency on assembling cued+pressure task sets.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly black-box study on public models, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only on open models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Within-model effort vs honesty correlation may be an open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Effort-as-honesty-signal within model is plausibly open.
